description: Fork of exp098 applying SparseScatter to qk_joint and v_lut as well: each is now MultiHeadLut(n_outputs=n_sparse_outputs, return_per_table_outputs=True) followed by SparseScatter(n_sparse_outputs -> n_outputs). qk_joint and v_lut: nap=8, tph=384, n_sparse=8 (per head). out_proj: nap=8, tph=2048, n_sparse=8 (unchanged from exp098). d_qk and d_v widened to 42 each (H*d_v=252, out_proj LUT 252 -> E=256). E=256, classic skip residual, linear unembedder unchanged.
